newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-SOUTH AFRICA ANNOUNCE TEST ITINERARY.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SOUTH AFRICA ANNOUNCE TEST ITINERARY.

text.p: South Africa are scheduled to play
three tests against Pakistan and two against Sri Lanka in 1998,
the United Cricket Board of South Africa (UCBSA) announced on
Wednesday.
South Africa will also play a series of one-day
internationals in a triangular tournament involving both
Pakistan and Sri Lanka in April of 1998.
Tour itinerary:
January 29 - Pakistan vs Nicky Oppenheimer XI,
Randjesfontein
January 31-February 3 - Pakistan vs Griqualand West,
Kimberley
February 6-9 - Pakistan vs Border, East London
February 13-17 - Pakistan vs South Africa, first test,
Johannesburg
February 20-23 - Pakistan vs Free State, Bloemfontein
February 26-March 2 - Pakistan vs South Africa, second test,
Durban
March 6-10 - Pakistan vs South Africa, third test, Port
Elizabeth
March 7-9 - Sri Lanka vs Transvaal, Johannesburg
March 11 - Sri Lanka vs North West, Fochville
